groups.label: Extraarticular, 2-part
groups.description: Unifocal fracture — isolated tuberosity or surgical neck. Articular segment and tuberosities remain united.

variants.label: Tuberosity fracture
variants.description: Avulsion of greater or lesser tuberosity without surgical neck involvement. Low displacement, good prognosis.

variants.label: Surgical neck, impacted
variants.description: Impacted valgus or varus surgical neck fracture. Stable configuration; often non-operative.

variants.label: Surgical neck, non-impacted
variants.description: Displaced or angulated surgical neck without impaction. Higher instability; often requires fixation.

treatments.label: Nonoperative treatment
treatments.main_indications: Impacted or minimally displaced fracture, elderly low-demand patient, isolated injury without neurovascular compromise

treatments.label: PHILOS locking plate
treatments.main_indications: Displaced surgical neck fracture in active patient with adequate bone quality; failed conservative management

treatments.label: Percutaneous / transdeltoid
treatments.main_indications: Minimally displaced tuberosity avulsion amenable to percutaneous screw fixation; limited soft tissue disruption

groups.label: Extraarticular, 3-part
groups.description: Bifocal fracture — one tuberosity plus surgical neck involvement. Rotator cuff disrupted unilaterally.

variants.label: Tuberosity + impaction
variants.description: Greater or lesser tuberosity fracture combined with impacted surgical neck.

variants.label: Tuberosity + dislocation
variants.description: Tuberosity fracture with glenohumeral dislocation. Requires urgent reduction.

variants.label: Metaphyseal extension
variants.description: Large metaphyseal fragment extending from surgical neck. Increased instability.

treatments.label: PHILOS locking plate
treatments.main_indications: 3-part fracture in patient with adequate bone quality and functional rotator cuff; younger active patient

treatments.label: Hemiarthroplasty
treatments.main_indications: Poor bone stock, significant osteoporosis, elderly high-demand patient, failed internal fixation

treatments.label: Nonoperative treatment
treatments.main_indications: Elderly low-demand patient, minimal displacement, high surgical risk, significant comorbidities

groups.label: Articular / 4-part
groups.description: Articular surface involved. Both tuberosities separated. High risk of avascular necrosis of humeral head.

variants.label: Slight displacement
variants.description: Articular fragment with minimal displacement. AVN risk lower; may attempt ORIF.

variants.label: Impaction (valgus/varus)
variants.description: Articular fragment impacted. Medial hinge may be intact — better vascular prognosis.

variants.label: Dislocation
variants.description: Articular segment with glenohumeral dislocation. Highest AVN risk; arthroplasty often indicated.

treatments.label: Reverse total shoulder arthroplasty
treatments.main_indications: Elderly patient (>65y), rotator cuff deficiency, severe osteoporosis, complex articular disruption

treatments.label: Hemiarthroplasty
treatments.main_indications: Elderly patient with intact rotator cuff, poor bone quality, unreconstructable head segment

treatments.label: PHILOS locking plate
treatments.main_indications: Young patient (<55y), intact medial hinge (11-C2), adequate bone quality, surgeon experience with 4-part ORIF

groups.label: Simple
groups.description: Single fracture line with cortical contact maintained. Three subtypes by fracture line orientation.

variants.label: Spiral
variants.description: Spiral fracture from low-energy torsional force. Common in throwing injuries.

variants.label: Oblique ≥ 30°
variants.description: Oblique fracture line greater than 30°. Intermediate energy.

variants.label: Transverse < 30°
variants.description: Transverse fracture from high-energy bending force.

treatments.label: Nonoperative treatment
treatments.main_indications: Closed isolated injury, minimally displaced, cooperative patient, midshaft location, no neurovascular compromise

treatments.label: Plate fixation
treatments.main_indications: Displaced fracture, polytrauma, associated radial nerve palsy (relative), proximal or distal shaft location, open fracture

treatments.label: Intramedullary nail (antegrade)
treatments.main_indications: Midshaft fracture, bilateral humeral fracture, polytrauma, pathological fracture

groups.label: Wedge
groups.description: Butterfly / wedge fragment present. Cortical contact maintained after reduction.

variants.label: Spiral wedge
variants.description: Spiral fracture with a butterfly fragment. Common in indirect trauma.

variants.label: Bending wedge
variants.description: Wedge fragment from bending force. Intact cortex on opposite side.

variants.label: Fragmented wedge
variants.description: Comminuted intermediate wedge fragment. Higher energy.

treatments.label: Nonoperative treatment
treatments.main_indications: Closed isolated midshaft wedge fracture, minimally displaced, cooperative patient

treatments.label: External fixation
treatments.main_indications: Unstable fracture, open fracture type II/III, unstable patient — usually temporary damage control

treatments.label: Plate fixation
treatments.main_indications: Displaced wedge fracture, failed conservative, polytrauma, pathological fracture, proximal/distal shaft extension

treatments.label: Intramedullary nail (antegrade)
treatments.main_indications: Midshaft wedge, bilateral injury, polytrauma, pathological bone

groups.label: Complex
groups.description: No cortical contact after reduction. High-energy comminution. Requires fixation.

variants.label: Spiral complex
variants.description: Multifragmentary spiral pattern. Long zone of comminution.

variants.label: Segmental
variants.description: Two distinct fracture lines creating an isolated diaphyseal segment.

variants.label: Irregular complex
variants.description: Highly comminuted, irregular fragments. Highest energy; significant soft tissue injury.

treatments.label: Plate fixation
treatments.main_indications: Complex comminution with proximal or distal extension, bone loss, failed IM nail, revision surgery

treatments.label: Intramedullary nail (antegrade)
treatments.main_indications: Segmental fracture, polytrauma, midshaft complex pattern, bilateral humeral fractures

treatments.label: External fixation
treatments.main_indications: Open fracture type III, highly unstable patient, temporary damage control before definitive fixation

groups.label: Extra-articular
groups.description: Articular surface intact. Fracture in the distal metaphysis or apophysis only.

variants.label: Apophyseal avulsion
variants.description: Avulsion of medial or lateral epicondyle / apophysis.

variants.label: Metaphyseal simple
variants.description: Simple distal metaphyseal fracture with intact articular surface.

variants.label: Metaphyseal multi-fragment
variants.description: Comminuted distal metaphysis without articular involvement.

treatments.label: Nonoperative treatment
treatments.main_indications: Non-displaced or minimally displaced metaphyseal fracture, elderly low-demand patient

treatments.label: ORIF — screw / plate
treatments.main_indications: Displaced epicondyle avulsion in active patient or athlete, displaced metaphyseal fracture with angulation

groups.label: Partial articular
groups.description: One part of the articular surface fractured; the other remains connected to the diaphysis.

variants.label: Lateral sagittal
variants.description: Capitellum or lateral condyle fracture in the sagittal plane.

variants.label: Medial sagittal
variants.description: Trochlea or medial condyle fracture in the sagittal plane.

variants.label: Frontal (shear)
variants.description: Capitellum or trochlea coronal shear fracture. Often requires screw fixation.

treatments.label: Lateral ORIF
treatments.main_indications: Capitellum fracture, lateral condyle, coronal shear (13-B1, 13-B3) — headless compression screws

treatments.label: Medial ORIF
treatments.main_indications: Trochlea or medial condyle fracture (13-B2) — medial approach with ulnar nerve transposition

treatments.label: Posterior ORIF
treatments.main_indications: Combined coronal shear with posterior instability, complex capitellum-trochlea involvement

groups.label: Complete articular
groups.description: Both medial and lateral columns fractured. Full articular disruption. Challenging reconstruction.

variants.label: Simple articular + simple metaphyseal
variants.description: T or Y fracture with simple lines in both columns.

variants.label: Simple articular + comminuted metaphyseal
variants.description: Simple articular lines but comminuted metaphysis. Bicolumnar fixation required.

variants.label: Multi-fragment articular
variants.description: Articular and metaphyseal comminution. Most severe pattern; consider arthroplasty in elderly.

treatments.label: Bicolumnar plate fixation
treatments.main_indications: Complete articular fracture in younger/active patient with reasonable bone quality (13-C1, 13-C2)

treatments.label: Total elbow arthroplasty
treatments.main_indications: Elderly osteoporotic patient (>65y), severe articular comminution (13-C3), unreconstructable articular surface

treatments.label: External fixation (bridge)
treatments.main_indications: Open fracture, severe soft tissue injury, temporary damage control before definitive reconstruction
